occupation.value: Senior Training Coordinator, Clark County Recorder's Office

citations.quote: I currently serve as Senior Training Coordinator in the Clark County Recorder’s Office and am a principal member of the administrative leadership team.
Flanagan, senior training coordinator in the recorder's office, is finishing out a term as a Democrat in the Assembly and has 23 years of experience working in Clark County government.
